discrete_graph.scope: Fixed supplied-rule discrete energy control; no learned extraction or rule discovery

feature_probes.scope: Diagnostic first-hop ridge probes at every layer. Predicted-label states for EBM; no gold conditioning. Network weights remain frozen. Probes themselves use first-hop supervision.

byte_energy_minus_bp_ce_bits.scope: 256 nonoverlapping target windows; residual text correlation limits this interval.

learned_discrete.scope: Exact marginalization over discrete paths. Seven learned scalar costs; supplied features, parser, and graph composition. No general language claim.
